name: TDEC Division of Water Resources Events Report (sewer overflows, releases, bypasses, upsets, washouts)
operator: Tennessee Department of Environment and Conservation
access_detail: Oracle APEX 24.2 interactive report, public (GUEST). Full CSV via f?p=2005:34140:<session>:CSV:::: using the session id the first GET redirects to (cookie jar). 2 MB, 12,857 rows on 2026-11-03. Sample raw/tdec-events-report-sample-2026-11-03.csv. Events Map page 34152 is an APEX spatial map with AJAX-loaded points (not tested).

sample_record.Project Name: Metro Water Services - Dry Creek Water Reclamation Facility

cadence: Newest event 10/29/2026 when fetched 11/03 (about 5 days; tracks the 5-day written report); 52 events in October 2026
license: Disclaimer quoted: "This table is provided for informational purposes only and should not be used to determine compliance."
status_reason: Read through the generic CSV reader (data/sources/tn-tdec-events-report.yaml): Tennessee's statewide table of every SSO, release, bypass, upset and washout since 2020, day precision, no receiving water, no CSO events. On 2026-11-07 the host answered 403 to the pipeline's identified client; the feed retries each run.
notes: Event types: SSO Wet Weather 5,817; Release [Sewer] Dry 3,067; SSO Dry 1,870; Release Wet 1,406; Bypass 591; Upset 41; Extreme Event 30; Unpermitted 23; Washout 10. 'Date Event Ended' blank on 11,104 rows. Memphis (TN0020711, TN0020729) has no rows at all. Official PDF for each event in the FileNet viewer https://tdec.tn.gov/document-viewer/search/SewerOF.

name: TDEC Document Viewer: Sewer Overflow event report PDFs (copy of record)
status_reason: Per-event PDFs from MyTDEC Forms (cause, receiving water likely); use to enrich large events.

name: Tenn. Comp. R. & Regs. 0400-40-05-.07 (permit terms: bypass, SSO prohibition, 24-hour reporting)
operator: Tennessee Water Quality Control Board / TDEC
status_reason: Regulator report within 24 hours, written within five days; no public notice.
notes: Quote (n)1: "For publicly owned treatment works (POTW) or domestic wastewater treatment plants, sanitary sewer overflows, including dry-weather overflows and wet weather overflows, are prohibited." (o): "In the case of any noncompliance, or any release (whether or not caused by improper operation and maintenance), which could cause a threat to human health or the environment, the permittee shall: 1. Report the noncompliance or release to the Commissioner within 24 hours from the time the permittee becomes aware of the circumstances. ... 2. Submit a written report within five days".

name: TDEC HAB Advisory Status (Survey123 layer behind the Tennessee HAB Dashboard)
access_detail: 71 records; advisory_issued values No / Precautionary Advisory (18) / No Contact Advisory (3). Saved only non-personal fields (raw/tn-hab-status-safe-fields-2026-11-03.json).
status_reason: Read through the generic ArcGIS reader (data/sources/tn-tdec-hab-advisory-status.yaml), advisory fields only: 71 bloom reports, 21 TDEC advisories with their dates (2026-11-07); the reporters' names, phones and emails are never requested.

status_reason: Read by ingest/tn_tdec_posted_streams.py: the posted-streams PDF's bacteriological table, 25 segments (Rev. August 2026), 21 naming sewer systems, as TDEC's standing water-contact advisories; no posting gives a date.

name: Clean Water Nashville monthly sanitary and combined sewer overflow reports
access_detail: Public monthly report index linking SSO and CSO PDFs; index verified on 2026-11-09. Individual PDF layouts and extraction have not been audited.
history: Monthly report links from January 2021 through September 2026 at the 2026-11-09 review.
status_reason: Dated overflow reports are publicly available in monthly PDFs. The index is monitored; report extraction and deduplication against TDEC records are not implemented.
notes: Availability of the monthly reports does not establish a real-time public-notice channel. Dates and fields are described by the official index; exact time precision requires inspection of the reports.

name: ORSANCO (Tennessee is not on the Ohio main stem)
status_reason: TN is an ORSANCO member state but its waters are Cumberland/Tennessee; no TN sampling site.

name: Knoxville Utilities Board, SSO Logs
waters_covered: KUB's wastewater service area, Knoxville and Knox County (no water named per row)
access_detail: The page loads its rows by month from https://www.kub.org/api/ams/v1/customer-sso-logs?date[]=<first>:greaterThanOrEquals&date[]=<last>:lessThanOrEquals&sort=date: date, time, location (street address), volume (gallons), status and completion date of the cleanup. 2,080 rows from January 2005 on 2026-11-17. No water, point, permit or person's name.
cadence: within 24 hours of the report (the page's words)
status_reason: Read hourly by pipeline/ingest/tn_kub_sso_log.py from 2026-11-17 (the previous and current month; --backfill to 2023-01-01): one dated record per row with its time, street and gallons, listed in Knox County and placed on no water. Status and Completion are the cleanup's, never the end of the overflow. A record of the same day and street as a TDEC Events Report record of a KUB permit is its duplicate.

name: City of Memphis, consent-decree quarterly SSO reports
waters_covered: Memphis's sewer service area (Shelby County): the streams the rows name (Nonconnah, Cypress, Fletcher, Days, Johns, Cane and Tenmile creeks, Black, Cherry and Workhouse bayous, the Wolf and Loosahatchie rivers and their tributaries)
access_detail: One PDF per quarter linked from the index (titles 'City of Memphis Quarterly Report- <first day> - <last day>'). The SSO table: Location - Address, Date and Time, Cause, Estimated Volume (gallons), Source, Duration (Hours), Receiving stream (if any), Unpermitted Discharge, Appendix G Area, and Priority Area or CD 11b & 11c; footnote marks ?, *, ** and † where no stream is named. The certification page carries an official's name and signature.
cadence: quarterly, posted about a month after the quarter ends
status_reason: Read hourly by pipeline/ingest/tn_memphis_cd_quarterly.py from 2026-11-17 (the index and the newest two reports; --backfill from 2023 Q1): one record per row with its date and time, street, gallons and estimated duration; placed only on the stream the row names, otherwise on no water, with the City's footnote on whether a water was reached. 652 rows from 14 reports on 2026-11-17; 31 rows in layouts not read are named in meta.

name: EPA ECHO monthly DMR CSO figures for Tennessee CSO permits (EPA's state DMR file)
access_detail: EPA ECHO's per-state DMR and limit ZIP per fiscal year (NPDES_by_state_year/TN_FY<yyyy>_NPDES_DMRS_LIMITS.zip), no key.
cannot_fill: the day or hour of a discharge
cadence: Weekly file; monthly figures, weeks' lag
legal_basis: NPDES permit monitoring and reporting conditions: results reported on a discharge monitoring report (40 CFR 122.41(l)(4)), filed electronically and shared with EPA (40 CFR part 127)
status_reason: Read by echo_dmr_cso_states (2026-11-21, decision 45): 151 outfall-months with a discharge from 2 of 3 permits, 2025-01 to 2026-08, received a median 14 days after the month. Month precision: the monthly mark only.
